procedure: Values were transcribed from the worked examples. Example 12.b supplies Greenwich mean and apparent sidereal time. Example 47.a supplies the Moon's apparent geocentric ecliptic longitude, latitude, and distance.
timeScale: UT for sidereal time; TD, treated as TT, for lunar position
frame: Greenwich sidereal angle for example 12.b; apparent geocentric ecliptic of date for example 47.a
accuracy: Published worked-example precision. The orb.js lunar model uses a four-term nutation approximation, so its longitude tolerance includes the approximately two-arcsecond model difference from the full nutation used by Meeus.
